subject: MAP: POC Environment Sprint — API keys, org setup, IP allowlist & VPC peering
messages:
From: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@betahealth.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Sabrina Cho <sabrina.cho@betahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 13:37:00 -0700
Subject: POC timeline — can we accelerate MAP and start env prep this week?

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at BetaHealth is aligned on trying Redwood in a two-week POC. We have a few non-negotiables for the test harness:

- Dedicated org for BetaHealth with SCIM-lite (just a single admin)
- API keys with per-key usage limits for auditability
- IP allowlist for our staging CIDR (10.50.0.0/22) and one IP for our on-prem proxy
- VPC peering or a managed tunnel — we prefer peering if possible

We'd like a mutual action plan (MAP) that spells out milestones and owner names so we can move fast. Is it possible to start provisioning org + API keys this week?

Attaching a short internal checklist for context.

Thanks,
Alex
Director, Integrations — BetaHealth
attachments: onboarding-checklist.pdf (summary)

From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@betahealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jun 2025 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC timeline — can we accelerate MAP and start env prep this week?

Alex — thanks for the clear ask and checklist. We can absolutely accelerate. Proposed approach (brief):

1) MAP spreadsheet (owner + milestone + target date) — I'll author the first draft and attach.
2) Org setup & API keys — we can create a BetaHealth "org" this afternoon; will provision one admin and generate scoped API keys (read-only for metrics + write for inference) that you can rotate.
3) IP allowlist — please confirm the exact source IPs; Jordan will validate peering feasibility.
4) VPC peering — we can request peering; timeline depends on your cloud team but typical turnaround is 48–72 hours after we exchange peering info. CloudOps partner can help if you prefer a managed tunnel.

I'll attach the MAP draft and an initial checklist. Jordan — can you draft the peering instructions and the allowlist guide? Marissa — I'll need a quick note on billing model for the trial and any temporary credits.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
attachments: MAP_v1.xlsx, poe-access-checklist.docx

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@betahealth.com>
Cc: CloudOps Partner <cloudops@partnerco.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 11:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC timeline — peering/allowlist details + next steps

Hi all — quick technical note and minimal action items to keep the POC on a 10 business day runway: 

- VPC peering prerequisites: BetaHealth needs to share VPC ID, account ID, and preferred route table. We do not require overlapping CIDRs; if ranges overlap we can fall back to a managed tunnel.
- IP allowlist: confirm the staging CIDR (you listed 10.50.0.0/22) and the single proxy IP — please validate those are NAT egress addresses.
- API keys: we'll generate two keys — one for ingestion (embed/generate) and one for admin telemetry. Keys are tagged and audited in Console.

I'm attaching a short peering checklist and a sample peering request that your cloud team can paste into their portal. If CloudOps Partner is leading the tunnel setup, loop their engineer and we'll coordinate the handoff.

On timeline: if we get your VPC info and signed MAP by EOD Friday (Jun 13), we can have peering request in flight and keys/org provisioned by Mon/Tue next week.

Jordan Blake
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
attachments: vpc-peering-instructions.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 13 Jun 2025 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC timeline — MAP & temporary billing credits

Alex — quick commercial note:

- For the 2-week POC we'll apply a trial credit of $2,500 against usage. If BetaHealth needs Dedicated capacity for the test we can price a short-term dev pool; otherwise hosted attribution applies.
- Please sign the MAP (attached) for internal approvals — once signed, we can enable the credits and proceed with org provisioning.

Neha — I'll prepare a short one-page statement of work that ties the MAP milestones to billing and a single point of contact for credits.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
AM — Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
